newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.

text.p: Ten stocks rose, three fell and 12 were flat in 12.7-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Wednesday with the WIG 20 index up 1.7 percent to 1,492.1 points.
The remaining five stocks did not trade.
NFI units rose 2.8 percent to 127 zlotys in a 13.7-million-zloty turnover.
The National Investment Fund NFI index rose 2.1 percent to 129.9 points in 1.3-million-zloty trade.
